coreAttributes.name: microphone
coreAttributes.description: A handheld microphone infused with demonstone to act as an arcane catalyst, the power of which can be used to sway emotions.
coreAttributes.equipText: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(focus)] on the energy in the demonstone infused instrument. As [npc.she] [npc.does] so, arcane power flows into [npc.her] aura, granting [npc.herHim] the ability to perform arcane-imbued attacks at range with the sound of the microphone.
coreAttributes.unequipText: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(focus)] on extracting the absorbed arcane energy inside of [npc.her] aura. As [npc.she] [npc.does] so, it flows back into the microphone.

hitDescriptions.hitText: Humming into the microphone, several music notes made of arcane energy materialise around [npc.name], before shooting out to strike [npc2.name]!
Twirling the microphone in [npc.her] [npc.hand], [npc.name] [npc.verb(create)] several music notes made of arcane energy around [npc.her], before shooting them at [npc2.name]!
[npc.Name] [npc.verb(sing)] into [npc.her] microphone, turning her voice into a powerful wave of arcane energy and sending it at [npc2.name]!

missDescriptions.missText: Humming into the microphone, several music notes made of arcane energy materialises around [npc.name], before shooting out and narrowly missing [npc2.name]!
Twirling the microphone in [npc.her] [npc.hand], [npc.name] [npc.verb(create)] several music notes made of arcane energy around [npc.her], before shooting them and narrowly missing [npc2.name]!
[npc.Name] [npc.verb(sing)] into [npc.her] microphone, turning her voice into a powerful wave of arcane energy and narrowly missing [npc2.name]!
